columns.comment: Workflow item id: credit review id (CRV-nnnnnn) or spreading task id (SPR-nnnnnn-FYyyyy).
columns.name: workflow_item_id

columns.comment: Credit Review or Financial Spreading.
columns.name: workflow_type

columns.comment: Annual (annual credit review), New Money (new facility / increase request), Amendment, Watchlist (watchlist review) or Financial Spreading (spreading of a statement year).
columns.name: review_type

columns.comment: Credit-system obligor id (CRD-nnnnnn) under review.
columns.name: obligor_id

columns.comment: Facility the review relates to (new money / amendment); null for annual, watchlist and spreading items.
columns.name: facility_id

columns.comment: Surrogate key of the dim_client version valid on this row's date (SCD2 as-was join, D11); join to gold.dim_client.golden_client_sk for the client attributes at that time.
columns.name: golden_client_sk

columns.comment: Durable golden client id from entity resolution (GC-nnnnnn), stable across ER runs and SCD2 versions; one golden client = one resolved legal entity.
columns.name: golden_client_id

columns.comment: Client group (global parent group) id from the Tokyo HO group master (SYN-G-nnnn); join to gold.dim_client_group.
columns.name: client_group_id

columns.comment: Grain date: due date (annual reviews, spreading tasks) or submission date (new money, amendment, watchlist); use for Month / quarter filters such as reviews due in Q3 FY2026.
columns.name: workflow_date

columns.comment: Statement fiscal year reviewed or spread (e.g. 2025 = the FY2025 financials); null for request-driven reviews.
columns.name: review_fiscal_year

columns.comment: Label of review_fiscal_year, e.g. FY2025.
columns.name: review_fiscal_year_label

columns.comment: Due date (annual reviews and spreading tasks; null for request-driven reviews).
columns.name: due_date

columns.comment: Preparation start (reviews) or statements received (spreading); null when not started.
columns.name: start_date

columns.comment: Memo submitted for approval (reviews) or statements spread (spreading); null when not yet.
columns.name: submitted_date

columns.comment: Approval / decision date (reviews) or spread checked (spreading); null while open.
columns.name: completed_date

columns.comment: Status at the as-of date. Reviews: Not Started, In Preparation, Overdue, Submitted - Awaiting Approval, Approved, Declined. Spreading: Received - Not Started, In Progress, Checked.
columns.name: status

columns.comment: Credit decision: Approved, Approved with Conditions or Declined (null while undecided and for spreading).
columns.name: outcome

columns.comment: True when decided (reviews) or checked (spreading).
columns.name: is_completed

columns.comment: True while the item is still open (not decided / not checked) at the as-of date.
columns.name: is_open

columns.comment: True for credit memos submitted but not yet decided at the as-of date (memos awaiting approval).
columns.name: is_awaiting_approval

columns.comment: True when the due date has passed (before 30-Sep-2026) and the memo / spread has not been submitted.
columns.name: is_overdue

columns.comment: Days past due at the as-of date for overdue items (0 otherwise).
columns.name: days_overdue

columns.comment: Days the memo / spread was submitted after its due date (0 = on time; null when not submitted or no due date). Sunda's FY2025 annual review = 23.
columns.name: days_late

columns.comment: True when submitted after the due date.
columns.name: was_submitted_late

columns.comment: Days from preparation start to submission (reviews; to the as-of date when still in preparation) or from receipt to spread (spreading).
columns.name: days_in_preparation

columns.comment: Days from preparation start (or statements received) to approval / check - end-to-end time to approval; null while open.
columns.name: days_to_approval

columns.comment: Days from submission to decision (credit approver turnaround); null while open.
columns.name: days_submission_to_approval

columns.comment: Number of times the memo was submitted (1 = approved on the first submission when approved).
columns.name: submission_count

columns.comment: True when approved (with or without conditions) on the first submission.
columns.name: approved_on_first_submission

columns.comment: True for spreading tasks whose statements are not yet spread (e.g. FY2025 financials not yet spread).
columns.name: is_not_yet_spread

columns.comment: Credit analyst preparing the memo / spreading (employee_id); join to gold.dim_employee.
columns.name: analyst_id

columns.comment: Credit approver deciding the memo, or the checker of a spread (employee_id); null until assigned.
columns.name: approver_id

columns.comment: Short excerpt of the credit memo (synthetic text, <= 40 words).
columns.name: memo_excerpt

columns.comment: Tone of the memo: Positive, Neutral or Negative.
columns.name: memo_tone

columns.comment: Sentiment of the memo text -1 (negative) .. 1 (positive).
columns.name: memo_sentiment_score

columns.comment: Why an overdue / delayed review is stuck (e.g. awaiting audited accounts); null otherwise.
columns.name: blocker_reason

columns.comment: Internal grade (1-10) at the start of the review.
columns.name: current_grade

columns.comment: Grade recommended by the analyst in the memo.
columns.name: recommended_grade

columns.comment: Grade approved by the credit approver.
columns.name: approved_grade

columns.comment: Amount requested (new-money reviews), USD.
columns.name: requested_amount_usd

columns.comment: Margin proposed in the memo (new money), basis points; weight by requested_amount_usd for averages.
columns.name: proposed_margin_bps

columns.comment: True when the new-money pricing was approved as an exception to the pricing grid.
columns.name: is_pricing_exception

columns.comment: Reason for the pricing exception (e.g. Relationship).
columns.name: exception_reason

columns.comment: Spreading tasks: Audited or Unaudited / Management statements.
columns.name: statement_basis

comment: Credit workflow (brief 5.3): one row per credit review (Annual, New Money, Amendment, Watchlist) or financial-spreading task (review_type = Financial Spreading; one per obligor and statement year), with due / start / submitted / completed dates, status and outcome, SLA flags as of 30-Sep-2026 (overdue, days overdue, awaiting approval, not yet spread), days late, days in preparation and to approval, submissions, analyst and approver (checker for spreading), memo excerpt and tone, grades and the new-money amount and margin. workflow_date (grain date) = due date for annual reviews and spreading tasks, submission date for new-money, amendment and watchlist reviews. For spreading tasks: start = statements received, submitted = spread, completed = checked. Reviews due in a future quarter (e.g. Q3 FY2026) are included with their current status.
